sanskrit_verse: अनेना भवति स्तेनः स्वकर्मप्रतिपादनात् । राजानं तत् स्पृशेद् एन उत्सृजन्तं सकिल्बिषम् ॥
transliteration: anenā bhavati stenaḥ svakarmapratipādanāt | rājānaṃ tat spṛśed ena utsṛjantaṃ sakilbiṣam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: By this act, one becomes a thief through misrepresentation of duty; such a one touches the king's domain while abandoning responsibility, thereby becoming impure in action.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently in alignment with Dharma, not in positional power alone.
Causation arises from conscious distortion of duty, not external compulsion.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of Dharma at the time of action.
Restoration logic requires re-alignment with original duty and purification of intent.
Consciousness alignment supersedes procedural compliance in determining juridical validity.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs an act under false representation of duty THEN agent incurs restorative liability UNTIL realignment with true dharma-function.
IF agent abandons responsibility WHILE engaging in governance-related activity THEN automatic suspension of operational capacity until purification process completes.
IF action results in domain contamination THEN initiate integrity-realignment protocol for all involved agents irrespective of hierarchical position.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any misrepresentation of constitutional duty by a judge or official constitutes inherent disqualification. The court must invoke immediate cessation of function and initiate consciousness-restoration protocols prior to reassessment of eligibility for office.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that distortion of svadharma manifests impurity in action (kilbiṣa). Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential deviation beginning with internal misalignment. Proportional responsibility lies in the degree of conscious deviation. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that correction occurs through restoration of original causal purity, not imposition of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svadharma Realignment Process: Reconnect individual consciousness with source-duty through guided realization.
Activate Kilbiṣa Dissolution Sequence: Remove residual impurities caused by distorted actions via ritualized completion procedures.
Deploy Sakilbiṣa Field Neutralization Protocol: Purify contaminated domains using collective intention-based cleansing mechanisms.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source-Authority of Dharma. Theft through falsified duty is nullified upon recognition. Justice operates solely for restoration, reintegration, and consciousness realignment. Reality reflects non-punitive truth. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator.
